Case reference: 2014003848.CaseDesc: On November 5, 1964, the Grand Rapids RCMP were advised that Harvey Hudson was two weeks overdue in returning from a trip to Cedar Lake from Grand Rapids, Manitoba. It was established that Harvey left The Pas on October 20th and arrived at the Cedar Lake Post.  When he reached Cedar Lake, he was told to wait for a boat from Easterville which was expected shortly. A witness said he walked to Easterville but turned back. He then took a canoe and set off for Easterville, using a piece of board as a paddle. It is believed that Harvey had little or no food, rifle or other camping supplies. Numerous land, air and water patrols were made with negative results.

Case reference: 2022060063.CaseDesc: Dustin Ireson's last contact was on November 13, 2022. His black Dodge Ram truck was found abandoned on November 24, 2022, in a parking lot near the Days Inn in Sarnia, Ontario.  During this period, Dustin was experiencing feelings of despondency.  Surveillance footage captured a man believed to be Dustin parking the truck and walking south toward the waterfront.  Despite extensive search efforts, Dustin's whereabouts remained unknown.

Tattoo: Unknown, Maple leaf with #11 in the middle of the leaf.
Right Abdomen, "IRESON" in vertical block letters on the left side

Case reference: 2014005768.CaseDesc: On March 16, 2012, Sol Han was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. That day, Sol did not show up for school.

Case reference: 2015058878.CaseDesc: Michel Richer was last seen on October 17, 2015, in Repentigny, Quebec. On October 23, 2015, he posted one last message on Facebook. On November 2, 2015, Michel's vehicle was found in the P1 parking lot at Mont-Tremblant, Quebec. Michel was known for his love of nature and forest walks.

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2014004122.CaseDesc: Maria Evangelista was last seen on January 27, 1997, in Montreal, Quebec. Maria had called her mother to tell her that she no longer wanted to return to the hospital and would like to work in California, United States of America. Maria's luggage was found in a hotel in San Francisco, California, USA, on February 7, 1997.

Case reference: 2024048307.CaseDesc: Margaret McCrae-Carreau was last seen at a medical appointment on May 24, 2016, when she was living in the Sandy Hill neighbourhood of Ottawa, Ontario.  It is out of character for her to be out of contact with her family. There have been no social media posts from her since November 2015. Margaret is legally blind and was on social assistance; her file was officially closed in May 2017, but has been suspended since August 2016 due to lack of contact.

Case reference: 2013000129.CaseDesc: Immaculate Basil was last seen June 14, 2013 on a road in a remote area north of Fort St James, BC.

Case reference: 2021006090.CaseDesc: At the end of July, 2019, Jonathan Fowler was seen for the last time in Picton, Ontario. Since then, there has not been any activity on his banking, phone and social media accounts. During the time of his disappearance, Jonathan was engaged in a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014004814.CaseDesc: Stephanie Stewart was employed as a Fire Spotter at the Athabasca Lookout near Hinton, Alberta when she disappeared on August 26, 2006. She was 70 years old at the time of her disappearance. Stephanie led an active lifestyle and was in good health. Her disappearance is being treated as suspicious. The police investigation is ongoing.

Case reference: 2014004932.CaseDesc: Mathieu Daneau's disappearance occurred on April 3, 2007 in the region of St-Hyacinthe, Quebec. Mathieu  was admitted for treatment at the L'Envolée Center. Mathieu left the center and has not been seen since.
